messages:
jess: Quick ask from marketplace team: AcmeCompute wants a joint perf/W bulletin. Can partnerships own a short benchmark?

mateo: I can run it. Propose model=redwood-micro, seq=512, batches [1,2,4], power caps [120W,160W,200W]. Aim to capture tokens/sec and avg power.

karen: vendor will provide acme-fw-2026-05 signed image and a telemetry agent. We should require no outbound agent by default for Private customers.

vendor-bot: firmware acme-fw-2026-05 uploaded to https://acme/artifacts/acme-fw-2026-05 (signed). agent acme-telemetry v2.0 available.

mateo: simple run loop: for b in 1 2 4; for p in 120 160 200; run_bench --model redwood-micro --seq 512 --batch $b --power $p --agent acme-telemetry --telemetry nvml

jess: timeline: reserve nodes for 24h next Wed, results slide + 1-paragraph blurb by Fri. Marketing wants superset numbers for listing.

karen: I'll ask Acme to co-author the blurb and confirm firmware rights for publishing numbers.

jess: action items: mateo reserve nodes + upload runbook; karen get firmware confirmation; I'll slot marketplace copy. Scheduling quick 15m check-in day before run.

mateo: will do. will also upload csvs to s3://redwood-partner-results/acme/1847012345/

jess: great, thanks. Closing thread, please post links here when available.
